 Today is the day. Our annual Fall presale opens in one hour, at 9:00 a.m. Eastern .

No minimum purchase, a very short window, returns extended to January 31 and free exchanges! 

 How the discounts work: 
 25% for 2 hours, from 9 to 11 a.m. this morning, with code LASCLAY25

 ALL PRODUCTS (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M2AQ96BXATWMQ8DFK35YCQ3X_0), including the new arrivals from May 2026 and Sept. 2026 (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M2AQ96BXATWMQ8DFK35YCQ3X_1)

 Why this presale is crucial to the future of Lasclay and of milkweed 
 
 This presale is far more than a chance to get products at a reduced price. It is quite literally essential to the future of Lasclay and of milkweed farming in Canada. 
 
 We are at a critical point. 
 
 Of the 125 milkweed growers who started out in Canada between 2014 and 2018, only 15 are left. They need income, hope and outlets to keep this crop going, a crop that has become a lifeline for monarch butterflies, now facing extinction. 
 

 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Le Devoir (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M2AQ96BXATWMQ8DFK35YCQ3X_8) and La Presse (https://ctrk.klclick.com/l/01M2AQ96BXATWMQ8DFK35YCQ3X_9) both recently ran troubling pieces on the state of monarch butterflies, which are on the brink of extinction and need support to survive. 
 
 With your contribution and your trust, we can get this wheel turning and open the way to a bright future for milkweed in Quebec , and make it a true flagship, which has been our ambition from day one. 
 
 This beautiful plant deserves it. The monarch butterflies deserve it. The courageous milkweed growers deserve it. And you, our loyal community who have been with us from the start, thank you for still being here 
 
 Are you ready? 
 
 You can pre-order every product in our shop right now, but the exclusive promo codes go live at 9:00 a.m. for the season's first buyers.
